craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 48. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 10. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In initiation of absent, beyond māyā, for enjoyment should join; desire for enjoyment rare indeed being, or for cessation of enjoyment.
l4.sanskrit_cite: parokṣadīkṣaṇe māyottīrṇe bhogāya yojayet bhogānīpsā durlabhā hi satī vā bhogahānaye
